subject: Clarify anomalous per-request taxonomy and VAT treatment — urgent billing hold
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@clearleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Adam Brier <adam.brier@clearleaf.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected per-request token counts on March invoice — request to pause collection

Hi Logan,

We pulled the March invoice and noticed a ~22% increase in per-request token counts versus our production logs. We've attached a small sample (clearleaf_sample_log.csv) showing the requests in question and the invoice PDF for reference.

Key callouts: 
- The affected requests are all routed through our /api/v1/classify endpoint — we believe a recent proxy rewrite caused header duplication and some requests to be replayed at the edge.
- VAT was applied at the EU rate for these requests; if token counts are duplicated that affects our VAT reclaim position for the quarter.

Can you confirm receipt and place the invoice on collection hold while your team investigates? We need the hold in place by end of day (our accounts payable runs on Fridays).

Attached: clearleaf_sample_log.csv (csv), clearleaf_invoice_202703.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance, ClearLeaf
M: +44 7700 900123

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@clearleaf.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected per-request token counts on March invoice — request to pause collection

Marta — thanks for the very clear report and the sample files. I've opened an internal billing investigation (case RB-20270414-095) and cc'd Kimberly (billing ops) and Marissa (collections) to coordinate the hold.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Kimberly will validate the sample trace against our tokenization and request logs to confirm whether duplication occurred on Redwood's edge or within ClearLeaf's proxy.
- If we confirm duplication, we'll calculate a provisional credit for March and share a revised invoice and VAT impact statement.
- We will keep the invoice on hold pending the outcome; Marissa will confirm collection suspension in our billing system.

Could you also share a short curl sample or the proxy config that was deployed in late February? That will speed root cause.

I'll follow up within 24 business hours with an initial status.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ClearLeaf — March token spike + VAT treatment (RB-20270414-095)

Kimberly / Marissa — looping you in with the samples from ClearLeaf. Quick notes from my call with Marta and Adam:

- They observed ~22% token inflation on March invoice tied to requests hitting /api/v1/classify. They suspect an edge replay due to a proxy rewrite around 2027-02-28.
- ClearLeaf is asking for a collection hold immediately and a VAT impact statement if we confirm duplication.

What I need from billing ops:
1) Kimberly — can you run a deviation compare between our ingress request IDs (2027-02-20 through 2027-03-31) and the tokenization output? Look specifically for duplicate request_ids and identical payloads that would indicate replays.
2) Marissa — please place invoice INV-202703-CL on hold in our system and flag for manual review. If we confirm duplication, prepare a provisional credit memo template we can send to ClearLeaf.

Timeline: initial check within 24 business hours, deeper forensic trace by EOD Thursday.

I included attachments they sent for your intake: clearleaf_sample_log.csv, clearleaf_invoice_202703.pdf

Thanks —
Logan

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@clearleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Adam Brier <adam.brier@clearleaf.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T15:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected per-request token counts on March invoice — request to pause collection

Logan — appreciate the fast response and the internal ticket. Adam and I dug into our proxy config and confirmed a canary rewrite was rolled out on 2027-02-28 that inadvertently duplicated an X-Request-ID header for a subset of paths. We're sharing the proxy snippet below and made a short test script that reproduces the duplication.

Proxy snippet (redacted):
- rewrite_header: X-Request-ID -> append-if-missing
- route: /api/v1/classify -> classification-service (pool)

We've paused the canary and are reprocessing logs now; we'll share the test curl and config export by EOD. For the moment, ClearLeaf formally requests:

- Invoice INV-202703-CL remain on hold until you validate the sample and issue any necessary credit.
- Provide a VAT impact statement (EUR amounts by tax type) so our tax team can update filings if a credit is issued.

If you prefer, we can sign a short amendment to the PO to formalize the adjust/credit workflow (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/clearleaf/po-mod-82345).

Thanks again — we want to resolve quickly and keep accounts payable moving.

Best,
Marta
Head of Finance, ClearLeaf
